mutations.name: you know is no longer a filler
kills: cleanTranscript removes um, uh and you know as filler spans

mutations.name: only single words count as repeats
kills: cleanTranscript removes an immediately repeated phrase

mutations.name: every later paragraph is a near-duplicate whatever the threshold
kills: cleanTranscript keeps a near-duplicate paragraph when the threshold is above its similarity

mutations.name: caller cut ranges are tagged as fillers
kills: cleanTranscript removes a caller-supplied cut range as sponsor-cut

mutations.name: two-byte characters count as one byte
kills: cleanTranscript reports byte offsets, not character offsets, for multibyte text
